title: ?author= filter uses substring LIKE match, not exact equality
evidence: app.py:107 SELECT ... WHERE author LIKE '%'||?||'%' — matches partial/case-insensitive author names
suggestion: Acceptable and arguably friendlier; document the semantics if exact-match is expected

title: GET /books returns full collection with no pagination
evidence: app.py:104 SELECT * FROM books ORDER BY id — unbounded result set
suggestion: Not required by the spec; add ?limit/?offset if large collections are anticipated
